**How it was checked**
<!-- Tests, and the real-data numbers: dataset, metric, the comparison with the authors' code or the published result
     (identical calls, largest difference, run time), also when they disappoint. -->

- [ ] Tests in the package whose code changed (known answers, the reference on a small real fixture, the calling convention)
- [ ] Every new dataset registered (`uchrom.datasets` / `apps/atlas/recipes/`) and documented in `apps/atlas/recipes/README.md`
- [ ] A line in the *Unreleased* section of `docs/source/reference/changelog.md`
- [ ] Docs: API page, chapter, tutorial re-executed (if changed)
- [ ] A re-implementation: its source in `docs/source/reference/license.md`
- [ ] Browser: `static/` rebuilt and `API.md` in sync (if changed)
